title: ACS 2020–2024 5-year Data Profiles (DP02–DP05): McKinney city, Texas
measures: Population, age shares, median age (DP05); households, language spoken at home, English ability, Spanish at home, foreign-born, bachelor's degree (DP02); median household income, mean travel time to work, worked from home, health insurance coverage incl. private, public and under-19 uninsured, SNAP (DP03); owner-occupancy (DP04). GEOID 160XX00US4845744. Companion tables: https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDP5Y2024.DP02?g=160XX00US4845744, https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDP5Y2024.DP03?g=160XX00US4845744, https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDP5Y2024.DP04?g=160XX00US4845744
limitations: Survey estimates with margins of error (recorded in the research file); 5-year period estimates (released in the 2024 vintage) describe 2020–2024 on average, not a single year. title: ACS 2020–2024 5-year Table C16001: Language Spoken at Home — McKinney city, Texas
measures: Population 5+ by language spoken at home: total 196,977 (±1,027); Spanish 21,525 (±2,034, 10.9%); Other Indo-European 10,773 (±1,438, 5.5%); Other Asian and Pacific Island 7,191 (±1,000, 3.7%); every other group 1.3% or less.
limitations: Survey estimates with margins of error; language groups are aggregated (e.g., 'Other Indo-European languages'); says nothing about which language patients prefer for health care.

title: Texas Tech Enrollment Soars Past 42,000 for the First Time
measures: 12th-class-day fall 2025 enrollment of 42,272 students (33,996 undergraduates, 8,276 graduate students), up more than 1,200 from fall 2024; fourth consecutive annual increase.
limitations: University press release; enrollment is not the same as Lubbock city residents and is not combined with Census figures.

title: Observation: sample of five McKinney dental practice homepages
measures: research/local/texas-mckinney-practices.md — observable homepage features (booking path, advertised hours, languages signposted, insurance/payment information, location content, reviews) on five practice websites found with WebSearch queries listed in the research file.
limitations: Small, non-random convenience sample of homepages on one date; describes websites, not demand, quality or revenue. The URL is a representative query link only; results were gathered with the WebSearch tool and the sites observed are listed in the research file, not on public pages.

title: Observation: agency pages returned for McKinney dental marketing searches
measures: research/competitors/texas-mckinney-agencies.md — positioning, services, proof, offers and unanswered questions on agency pages returned by the WebSearch tool for 'dental marketing agency McKinney' and 'dental SEO McKinney'.
limitations: WebSearch tool results (US, unordered list), not a Google ranking. No traffic, spend or results inferred. Representative query link only; pages observed are listed in the research file, not on public pages.
